title: Order your cake in Hindi or Gujarati near Pendle Hill and Girraween
summary:
Some cake details are easier to explain in the language you think in. At our Harris Park counter you can order in English, Hindi or Gujarati.

Families from Pendle Hill, Girraween and Westmead bring a photo, the name to go on top, and the details that are hard to put into English: the colours a grandmother picked, the theme for a first birthday, the change from last year's cake. We make custom cakes to any design, and every one is 100% eggless, so nobody has to ask.

15 flavours, including Rasmalai and Mango. A 6-inch serves 6–8 from $39.99; an 8-inch serves 12–14 from $49.99. Order at least 2 days ahead. Pickup only, from Shop 1, 96–98 Wigram Street, Harris Park, open 11am to 10pm daily.

Same cake. Less lost in translation. 🎂
